events_retention_floor.name: events_retention_floor
events_retention_floor.using: delivered_at is not null and occurred_at < now() - interval '1 day'

native_apps_ios_whole.name: native_apps_ios_whole
native_apps_ios_whole.value: "auth"."native_apps"."platform" <> 'ios' or ("auth"."native_apps"."team_id" is not null and "auth"."native_apps"."team_id" ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{10}$' and cardinality("auth"."native_apps"."sha256_cert_fingerprints") = 0)

native_apps_android_whole.name: native_apps_android_whole
native_apps_android_whole.value: "auth"."native_apps"."platform" <> 'android' or ("auth"."native_apps"."team_id" is null and cardinality("auth"."native_apps"."sha256_cert_fingerprints") between 1 and 10)

native_apps_fingerprints_shape.name: native_apps_fingerprints_shape
native_apps_fingerprints_shape.value: array_position("auth"."native_apps"."sha256_cert_fingerprints", null) is null and array_to_string("auth"."native_apps"."sha256_cert_fingerprints", ',') ~ '^(([0-9A-F]{2}:){31}[0-9A-F]{2}(,([0-9A-F]{2}:){31}[0-9A-F]{2})*)?$' and char_length(array_to_string("auth"."native_apps"."sha256_cert_fingerprints", ',')) = greatest(96 * cardinality("auth"."native_apps"."sha256_cert_fingerprints") - 1, 0)

native_apps_app_link_paths_shape.name: native_apps_app_link_paths_shape
native_apps_app_link_paths_shape.value: cardinality("auth"."native_apps"."app_link_paths") <= 10 and array_position("auth"."native_apps"."app_link_paths", null) is null and array_to_string("auth"."native_apps"."app_link_paths", ',') ~ '^((/[A-Za-z0-9._~-]+)+(,(/[A-Za-z0-9._~-]+)+)*)?$' and array_to_string("auth"."native_apps"."app_link_paths", ',') !~ '/\.\.?(/|,|$)' and char_length(array_to_string("auth"."native_apps"."app_link_paths", ',')) - char_length(replace(array_to_string("auth"."native_apps"."app_link_paths", ','), ',', '')) = greatest(cardinality("auth"."native_apps"."app_link_paths") - 1, 0) and char_length(array_to_string("auth"."native_apps"."app_link_paths", ',')) <= 2560 and (cardinality("auth"."native_apps"."app_link_paths") = 0 or char_length(array_to_string("auth"."native_apps"."app_link_paths", ',')) >= 2)

proposals_approval_whole.name: proposals_approval_whole
proposals_approval_whole.value: ("auth"."proposals"."status" = 'pending') = ("auth"."proposals"."approved_at" is null) and ("auth"."proposals"."status" = 'pending') = ("auth"."proposals"."approved_by_type" is null) and ("auth"."proposals"."approved_by_type" is null or "auth"."proposals"."approved_by_type" in ('admin', 'instance_admin')) and ("auth"."proposals"."approved_by_id" is null or ("auth"."proposals"."approved_by_type" is not null and char_length("auth"."proposals"."approved_by_id") between 1 and 128))

proposals_failure_whole.name: proposals_failure_whole
proposals_failure_whole.value: ("auth"."proposals"."status" = 'failed') = ("auth"."proposals"."failure_reason" is not null) and ("auth"."proposals"."failure_reason" is null or "auth"."proposals"."failure_reason" ~ '^[a-z_]{1,64}$')

users_email_whole.name: users_email_whole
users_email_whole.value: ("auth"."users"."email" IS NULL) = ("auth"."users"."email_normalized" IS NULL) AND ("auth"."users"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "auth"."users"."email_verified_at" IS NULL)

users_sms_factor_needs_number.name: users_sms_factor_needs_number
users_sms_factor_needs_number.value: "auth"."users"."sms_factor_enabled_at" IS NULL OR "auth"."users"."phone_number" IS NOT NULL

webhook_deliveries_retention_floor.name: webhook_deliveries_retention_floor
webhook_deliveries_retention_floor.using: state <> 'pending' and created_at < now() - interval '7 days'

consent_form_token_shape.name: consent_form_token_shape
consent_form_token_shape.value: "core"."consent_form"."token" is null or (char_length("core"."consent_form"."token") between 22 and 256 and "core"."consent_form"."token" collate "C" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$')

consent_form_lifecycle.name: consent_form_lifecycle
consent_form_lifecycle.value:
("core"."consent_form"."state" = 'draft') = ("core"."consent_form"."published_at" is null)
        and ("core"."consent_form"."state" = 'draft') = ("core"."consent_form"."token" is null)
        and ("core"."consent_form"."state" = 'closed') = ("core"."consent_form"."closed_at" is not null)

contact_check_log_outcome_consistent.name: contact_check_log_outcome_consistent
contact_check_log_outcome_consistent.value:
("core"."contact_check_log"."allowed" and "core"."contact_check_log"."basis" is not null and "core"."contact_check_log"."code" is null)
        or (not "core"."contact_check_log"."allowed" and "core"."contact_check_log"."basis" is null and "core"."contact_check_log"."code" is not null)

contact_consent_event_grant_has_evidence.name: contact_consent_event_grant_has_evidence
contact_consent_event_grant_has_evidence.value: "core"."contact_consent_event"."kind" <> 'granted' or ("core"."contact_consent_event"."wording_id" is not null and "core"."contact_consent_event"."evidence_ref" is not null)

contact_consent_event_submission_matches.name: contact_consent_event_submission_matches_source
contact_consent_event_submission_matches.value:
("core"."contact_consent_event"."source" = 'hosted_form') = ("core"."contact_consent_event"."ip_address" is not null and "core"."contact_consent_event"."user_agent" is not null)
        and ("core"."contact_consent_event"."ip_address" is null) = ("core"."contact_consent_event"."user_agent" is null)
        and ("core"."contact_consent_event"."ip_address" is null or char_length("core"."contact_consent_event"."ip_address") between 1 and 64)
        and ("core"."contact_consent_event"."user_agent" is null or char_length("core"."contact_consent_event"."user_agent") <= 512)

suppression_entry_masked_address_shape.name: suppression_entry_masked_address_shape
suppression_entry_masked_address_shape.value:
("core"."suppression_entry"."reason" = 'erased') = ("core"."suppression_entry"."masked_address" is null)
        and ("core"."suppression_entry"."masked_address" is null or char_length("core"."suppression_entry"."masked_address") between 1 and 100)

suppression_entry_removal_complete.name: suppression_entry_removal_complete
suppression_entry_removal_complete.value:
("core"."suppression_entry"."removed_at" is null) = ("core"."suppression_entry"."removed_by_user_id" is null)
        and ("core"."suppression_entry"."removed_at" is null) = ("core"."suppression_entry"."removal_reason" is null)

suppression_entry_removal_reason_shape.name: suppression_entry_removal_reason_shape
suppression_entry_removal_reason_shape.value:
"core"."suppression_entry"."removal_reason" is null or (char_length("core"."suppression_entry"."removal_reason") between 1 and 500
        and "core"."suppression_entry"."removal_reason" = btrim("core"."suppression_entry"."removal_reason"))

crm_connection_sealed_tokens_have_key_id.name: crm_connection_sealed_tokens_have_key_id
crm_connection_sealed_tokens_have_key_id.value: ("core"."crm_connection"."access_token_sealed" is null and "core"."crm_connection"."refresh_token_sealed" is null) or "core"."crm_connection"."token_key_id" is not null

crm_connection_access_expiry_needs_token.name: crm_connection_access_expiry_needs_token
crm_connection_access_expiry_needs_token.value: "core"."crm_connection"."access_token_expires_at" is null or "core"."crm_connection"."access_token_sealed" is not null

crm_external_ref_state_columns.name: crm_external_ref_state_columns
crm_external_ref_state_columns.value:
("core"."crm_external_ref"."state" = 'pending_write' and "core"."crm_external_ref"."write_key" is not null)
        or ("core"."crm_external_ref"."state" in ('linked', 'unlinked') and "core"."crm_external_ref"."external_id" is not null)

crm_mapping_label_shape.name: crm_mapping_label_shape
crm_mapping_label_shape.value: "core"."crm_mapping"."label" is null or char_length("core"."crm_mapping"."label") between 1 and 200

crm_mapping_kind_columns.name: crm_mapping_kind_columns
crm_mapping_kind_columns.value:
("core"."crm_mapping"."kind" = 'stage' and "core"."crm_mapping"."outcome" is not null and "core"."crm_mapping"."direction" is null)
        or ("core"."crm_mapping"."kind" = 'field' and "core"."crm_mapping"."direction" is not null and "core"."crm_mapping"."outcome" is null and "core"."crm_mapping"."label" is null and "core"."crm_mapping"."key" in ('deal.outcome', 'company.name', 'company.domain', 'company.industry', 'company.employeeCount', 'company.region', 'company.technologies', 'contact.firstName', 'contact.lastName', 'contact.jobTitle', 'contact.email', 'contact.phone', 'contact.linkedinUrl', 'activity.notes'))

crm_sync_run_counts_bounds.name: crm_sync_run_counts_bounds
crm_sync_run_counts_bounds.value:
"core"."crm_sync_run"."created_count" between 0 and 100000000
        and "core"."crm_sync_run"."updated_count" between 0 and 100000000
        and "core"."crm_sync_run"."skipped_count" between 0 and 100000000
        and "core"."crm_sync_run"."failed_count" between 0 and 100000000
        and "core"."crm_sync_run"."unlinked_count" between 0 and 100000000

crm_sync_run_lifecycle.name: crm_sync_run_lifecycle
crm_sync_run_lifecycle.value:
("core"."crm_sync_run"."state" = 'queued' and "core"."crm_sync_run"."started_at" is null and "core"."crm_sync_run"."completed_at" is null)
        or ("core"."crm_sync_run"."state" = 'running' and "core"."crm_sync_run"."started_at" is not null and "core"."crm_sync_run"."completed_at" is null)
        or ("core"."crm_sync_run"."state" in ('completed', 'failed') and "core"."crm_sync_run"."completed_at" is not null)

demo_request_work_email_shape.name: demo_request_work_email_shape
demo_request_work_email_shape.value:
"core"."demo_request"."work_email" = lower("core"."demo_request"."work_email" collate "C")
        and char_length("core"."demo_request"."work_email") between 3 and 320
        and char_length("core"."demo_request"."work_email") - char_length(replace("core"."demo_request"."work_email", '@', '')) = 1
        and position('@' in "core"."demo_request"."work_email") between 2 and char_length("core"."demo_request"."work_email") - 1
        and "core"."demo_request"."work_email" collate "C" !~ '[[:space:][:cntrl:]]'
        and "core"."demo_request"."work_email" collate "C" ~ '^[!-~]+$'

prospect_companies_domain_shape.name: prospect_companies_domain_shape
prospect_companies_domain_shape.value:
"core"."prospect_companies"."domain" is null or (char_length("core"."prospect_companies"."domain") between 3 and 253
        and "core"."prospect_companies"."domain" collate "C" ~ '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)+$')

prospect_companies_industry_shape.name: prospect_companies_industry_shape
prospect_companies_industry_shape.value: "core"."prospect_companies"."industry" is null or (char_length("core"."prospect_companies"."industry") between 1 and 200 and "core"."prospect_companies"."industry" = btrim("core"."prospect_companies"."industry"))

prospect_companies_region_shape.name: prospect_companies_region_shape
prospect_companies_region_shape.value: "core"."prospect_companies"."region" is null or (char_length("core"."prospect_companies"."region") between 1 and 200 and "core"."prospect_companies"."region" = btrim("core"."prospect_companies"."region"))

prospect_company_fields_source_ref_shape.name: prospect_company_fields_source_ref_shape
prospect_company_fields_source_ref_shape.value: ("source_ref" is null or char_length("source_ref") between 1 and 200) and ("source" <> 'manual' or "source_ref" is null)

prospect_company_fields_value_shape.name: prospect_company_fields_value_shape
prospect_company_fields_value_shape.value: ("field_name" <> 'technologies' and char_length("value") between 1 and 320) or ("field_name" = 'technologies' and char_length("value") between 1 and 5300 and core.prospect_company_technologies_text_valid("value"))

prospect_fields_source_ref_shape.name: prospect_fields_source_ref_shape
prospect_fields_source_ref_shape.value: ("source_ref" is null or char_length("source_ref") between 1 and 200) and ("source" <> 'manual' or "source_ref" is null)

prospect_identities_value_shape.name: prospect_identities_value_shape
prospect_identities_value_shape.value:
char_length("core"."prospect_identities"."value") between 3 and 320 and (
        ("core"."prospect_identities"."kind" = 'email'
          and "core"."prospect_identities"."value" = lower("core"."prospect_identities"."value" collate "C")
          and char_length("core"."prospect_identities"."value") - char_length(replace("core"."prospect_identities"."value", '@', '')) = 1
          and position('@' in "core"."prospect_identities"."value") between 2 and char_length("core"."prospect_identities"."value") - 1
          and "core"."prospect_identities"."value" collate "C" ~ '^[!-~]+$')
        or ("core"."prospect_identities"."kind" = 'phone' and "core"."prospect_identities"."value" collate "C" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$')
        or ("core"."prospect_identities"."kind" = 'linkedin' and char_length("core"."prospect_identities"."value") <= 300
          and "core"."prospect_identities"."value" collate "C" ~ '^linkedin\.com(/[a-z0-9%._~-]+)+$'))

prospect_import_rows_reason_matches_resu.name: prospect_import_rows_reason_matches_result
prospect_import_rows_reason_matches_resu.value:
("core"."prospect_import_rows"."result" = 'skipped' and "core"."prospect_import_rows"."reason" is not null and "core"."prospect_import_rows"."reason" in ('no_change', 'manual_values_kept'))
        or ("core"."prospect_import_rows"."result" = 'rejected' and "core"."prospect_import_rows"."reason" is not null and "core"."prospect_import_rows"."reason" in ('wrong_column_count', 'blank_row', 'missing_identity', 'invalid_email', 'invalid_phone', 'invalid_linkedin_url', 'invalid_name', 'invalid_job_title', 'invalid_company', 'invalid_tags', 'owner_not_found', 'owner_not_allowed', 'duplicate_in_file', 'identity_conflict'))
        or ("core"."prospect_import_rows"."result" in ('created', 'updated') and "core"."prospect_import_rows"."reason" is null)

prospect_import_rows_prospect_matches_re.name: prospect_import_rows_prospect_matches_result
prospect_import_rows_prospect_matches_re.value:
("core"."prospect_import_rows"."result" = 'rejected' and "core"."prospect_import_rows"."prospect_id" is null)
        or ("core"."prospect_import_rows"."result" in ('created', 'updated') and "core"."prospect_import_rows"."prospect_id" is not null)
        or "core"."prospect_import_rows"."result" = 'skipped'

prospect_imports_counts_when_completed.name: prospect_imports_counts_when_completed
prospect_imports_counts_when_completed.value:
("core"."prospect_imports"."state" = 'completed') = ("core"."prospect_imports"."row_count" is not null)
        and ("core"."prospect_imports"."row_count" is null) = ("core"."prospect_imports"."created_count" is null)
        and ("core"."prospect_imports"."row_count" is null) = ("core"."prospect_imports"."updated_count" is null)
        and ("core"."prospect_imports"."row_count" is null) = ("core"."prospect_imports"."skipped_count" is null)
        and ("core"."prospect_imports"."row_count" is null) = ("core"."prospect_imports"."rejected_count" is null)

prospect_imports_counts_add_up.name: prospect_imports_counts_add_up
prospect_imports_counts_add_up.value:
"core"."prospect_imports"."row_count" is null or ("core"."prospect_imports"."created_count" >= 0 and "core"."prospect_imports"."updated_count" >= 0
        and "core"."prospect_imports"."skipped_count" >= 0 and "core"."prospect_imports"."rejected_count" >= 0
        and "core"."prospect_imports"."row_count" <= 50000
        and "core"."prospect_imports"."row_count" = "core"."prospect_imports"."created_count" + "core"."prospect_imports"."updated_count" + "core"."prospect_imports"."skipped_count" + "core"."prospect_imports"."rejected_count")

prospects_notes_shape.name: prospects_notes_shape
prospects_notes_shape.value: "core"."prospects"."notes" is null or char_length("core"."prospects"."notes") between 1 and 5000

invitations_email_shape.name: invitations_email_shape
invitations_email_shape.value:
"core"."invitations"."email" = lower("core"."invitations"."email" collate "C")
        and char_length("core"."invitations"."email") between 3 and 320
        and char_length("core"."invitations"."email") - char_length(replace("core"."invitations"."email", '@', '')) = 1
        and position('@' in "core"."invitations"."email") between 2 and char_length("core"."invitations"."email") - 1
        and "core"."invitations"."email" collate "C" !~ '[[:space:][:cntrl:]]'
        and "core"."invitations"."email" collate "C" ~ '^[!-~]+$'

invitations_state_shape.name: invitations_state_shape
invitations_state_shape.value:
("core"."invitations"."state" = 'pending' and "core"."invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "core"."invitations"."revoked_at" is null)
        or ("core"."invitations"."state" = 'accepted' and "core"."invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "core"."invitations"."revoked_at" is null)
        or ("core"."invitations"."state" = 'revoked' and "core"."invitations"."revoked_at" is not null and "core"."invitations"."accepted_at" is null)

memberships_email_shape.name: memberships_email_shape
memberships_email_shape.value:
"core"."memberships"."email" = lower("core"."memberships"."email" collate "C")
        and char_length("core"."memberships"."email") between 3 and 320
        and char_length("core"."memberships"."email") - char_length(replace("core"."memberships"."email", '@', '')) = 1
        and position('@' in "core"."memberships"."email") between 2 and char_length("core"."memberships"."email") - 1
        and "core"."memberships"."email" collate "C" !~ '[[:space:][:cntrl:]]'
        and "core"."memberships"."email" collate "C" ~ '^[!-~]+$'

calls_cleanup_idx.name: calls_cleanup_idx
calls_cleanup_idx.where: state = 'deleted' and (vectors_removed_seq is null or vectors_removed_seq < deletion_seq)

calls_duration_bounds.name: calls_duration_bounds
calls_duration_bounds.value:
"playbook"."calls"."duration_seconds" is null or ("playbook"."calls"."duration_seconds" between 1 and 10800
        and "playbook"."calls"."kind" = 'recording')

calls_rep_shape.name: calls_rep_shape
calls_rep_shape.value:
("playbook"."calls"."rep_by" is null and "playbook"."calls"."rep_label" is null and "playbook"."calls"."rep_channel" is null)
        or ("playbook"."calls"."rep_by" = 'speaker' and "playbook"."calls"."rep_label" is not null and "playbook"."calls"."rep_channel" is null)
        or ("playbook"."calls"."rep_by" = 'channel' and "playbook"."calls"."rep_channel" is not null and "playbook"."calls"."rep_label" is null
            and "playbook"."calls"."kind" = 'recording')

calls_rep_label_shape.name: calls_rep_label_shape
calls_rep_label_shape.value:
"playbook"."calls"."rep_label" is null or char_length("playbook"."calls"."rep_label") between 1 and 64
      and octet_length("playbook"."calls"."rep_label") <= 256

calls_ready_label_listed.name: calls_ready_label_listed
calls_ready_label_listed.value: "playbook"."calls"."state" <> 'ready' or "playbook"."calls"."rep_by" is distinct from 'speaker' or "playbook"."calls"."rep_label" = any("playbook"."calls"."speaker_labels")

calls_seq_bounds.name: calls_seq_bounds
calls_seq_bounds.value:
"playbook"."calls"."epoch" >= 0 and "playbook"."calls"."deletion_seq" >= 0
        and "playbook"."calls"."rep_seq" between 0 and 2147483647
        and "playbook"."calls"."tagged_outcome_seq" between 0 and 2147483647

calls_deleted_has_times.name: calls_deleted_has_times
calls_deleted_has_times.value:
("playbook"."calls"."state" = 'deleted') = ("playbook"."calls"."deleted_at" is not null)
        and ("playbook"."calls"."state" = 'deleted') = ("playbook"."calls"."purge_due_at" is not null)

calls_purge_only_when_deleted.name: calls_purge_only_when_deleted
calls_purge_only_when_deleted.value:
("playbook"."calls"."purge_started_at" is null or "playbook"."calls"."state" = 'deleted')
        and ("playbook"."calls"."purge_started_at" is null) = ("playbook"."calls"."purge_lease_until" is null)
        and ("playbook"."calls"."purge_started_at" is null) = ("playbook"."calls"."purge_attempts" = 0)

calls_vendor_removal_after_send.name: calls_vendor_removal_after_send
calls_vendor_removal_after_send.value: "playbook"."calls"."vendor_removed_at" is null or "playbook"."calls"."sent_to_vendor_at" is not null

consumed_message_state_columns.name: consumed_message_state_columns
consumed_message_state_columns.value:
("playbook"."consumed_message"."state" = 'claimed' and "playbook"."consumed_message"."lease_expires_at" is not null and "playbook"."consumed_message"."completed_at" is null)
        or ("playbook"."consumed_message"."state" = 'done' and "playbook"."consumed_message"."lease_expires_at" is null and "playbook"."consumed_message"."completed_at" is not null)

deal_import_rows_first_key.name: deal_import_rows_first_key
deal_import_rows_first_key.where: "playbook"."deal_import_rows"."deal_id" is not null and "playbook"."deal_import_rows"."reason" is distinct from 'duplicate_in_file'

deal_import_rows_deal_id_shape.name: deal_import_rows_deal_id_shape
deal_import_rows_deal_id_shape.value:
"playbook"."deal_import_rows"."deal_id" is null or (char_length("playbook"."deal_import_rows"."deal_id") between 1 and 128
        and octet_length("playbook"."deal_import_rows"."deal_id") <= 512)

deal_imports_counts_range.name: deal_imports_counts_range
deal_imports_counts_range.value:
"playbook"."deal_imports"."applied_count" between 0 and 50000
        and "playbook"."deal_imports"."rejected_count" between 0 and 50000
        and "playbook"."deal_imports"."applied_count" + "playbook"."deal_imports"."rejected_count" <= 50000

deal_imports_row_count_matches_state.name: deal_imports_row_count_matches_state
deal_imports_row_count_matches_state.value:
("playbook"."deal_imports"."state" = 'completed') = ("playbook"."deal_imports"."row_count" is not null)
        and ("playbook"."deal_imports"."row_count" is null or "playbook"."deal_imports"."row_count" = "playbook"."deal_imports"."applied_count" + "playbook"."deal_imports"."rejected_count")

deals_deal_id_shape.name: deals_deal_id_shape
deals_deal_id_shape.value:
char_length("playbook"."deals"."deal_id") between 1 and 128
        and octet_length("playbook"."deals"."deal_id") <= 512
        and "playbook"."deals"."deal_id" = btrim("playbook"."deals"."deal_id", E' \t\n\r\f\v')

deals_name_shape.name: deals_name_shape
deals_name_shape.value:
"playbook"."deals"."name" is null or (char_length("playbook"."deals"."name") between 1 and 200
        and octet_length("playbook"."deals"."name") <= 800)

deals_amount_has_currency.name: deals_amount_has_currency
deals_amount_has_currency.value: "playbook"."deals"."amount" is null or "playbook"."deals"."currency" is not null

documents_cleanup_idx.name: documents_cleanup_idx
documents_cleanup_idx.where: state = 'deleted' and (vectors_removed_seq is null or vectors_removed_seq < deletion_seq)

documents_deleted_has_times.name: documents_deleted_has_times
documents_deleted_has_times.value:
("playbook"."documents"."state" = 'deleted') = ("playbook"."documents"."deleted_at" is not null)
        and ("playbook"."documents"."state" = 'deleted') = ("playbook"."documents"."purge_due_at" is not null)

documents_purge_only_when_deleted.name: documents_purge_only_when_deleted
documents_purge_only_when_deleted.value:
("playbook"."documents"."purge_started_at" is null or "playbook"."documents"."state" = 'deleted')
        and ("playbook"."documents"."purge_started_at" is null) = ("playbook"."documents"."purge_lease_until" is null)
        and ("playbook"."documents"."purge_started_at" is null) = ("playbook"."documents"."purge_attempts" = 0)

ingestion_jobs_counts_bounds.name: ingestion_jobs_counts_bounds
ingestion_jobs_counts_bounds.value:
"playbook"."ingestion_jobs"."page_count" between 1 and 100000
        and "playbook"."ingestion_jobs"."chunk_count" between 0 and 1000000
        and "playbook"."ingestion_jobs"."chunks_done" >= 0 and "playbook"."ingestion_jobs"."chunks_done" <= coalesce("playbook"."ingestion_jobs"."chunk_count", 0)

call_events_state_change.name: call_events_state_change
call_events_state_change.value:
("voice"."call_events"."kind" = 'state_changed') = ("voice"."call_events"."to_state" is not null)
        and ("voice"."call_events"."from_state" is null or "voice"."call_events"."to_state" is not null)

calls_idempotency_shape.name: calls_idempotency_shape
calls_idempotency_shape.value:
("voice"."calls"."idempotency_key" is null) = ("voice"."calls"."request_fingerprint" is null)
        and ("voice"."calls"."idempotency_key" is null or char_length("voice"."calls"."idempotency_key") between 1 and 255)
        and ("voice"."calls"."request_fingerprint" is null or "voice"."calls"."request_fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

calls_disclosure_all_or_none.name: calls_disclosure_all_or_none
calls_disclosure_all_or_none.value:
("voice"."calls"."disclosure_wording_version" is null) = ("voice"."calls"."disclosure_played_at" is null)
        and ("voice"."calls"."disclosure_wording_version" is null or "voice"."calls"."disclosure_wording_version" >= 1)

calls_live_has_disclosure.name: calls_live_has_disclosure
calls_live_has_disclosure.value: "voice"."calls"."state" not in ('live', 'ended') or "voice"."calls"."disclosure_played_at" is not null

calls_disclosure_failure.name: calls_disclosure_failure
calls_disclosure_failure.value: "voice"."calls"."failure_reason" is distinct from 'disclosure_failed' or "voice"."calls"."disclosure_played_at" is null

calls_times_ordered.name: calls_times_ordered
calls_times_ordered.value:
("voice"."calls"."answered_at" is null or "voice"."calls"."answered_at" >= "voice"."calls"."created_at")
        and ("voice"."calls"."ended_at" is null or "voice"."calls"."ended_at" >= "voice"."calls"."created_at")
        and ("voice"."calls"."answered_at" is null or "voice"."calls"."ended_at" is null or "voice"."calls"."ended_at" >= "voice"."calls"."answered_at")

calls_wrap_up_only_ended.name: calls_wrap_up_only_ended
calls_wrap_up_only_ended.value: "voice"."calls"."state" = 'ended' or ("voice"."calls"."deal_id" is null and "voice"."calls"."note" is null)

calls_deal_id_shape.name: calls_deal_id_shape
calls_deal_id_shape.value:
"voice"."calls"."deal_id" is null or (char_length("voice"."calls"."deal_id") between 1 and 128
        and octet_length("voice"."calls"."deal_id") <= 512
        and "voice"."calls"."deal_id" = btrim("voice"."calls"."deal_id", E' \t\n\r\f\v'))

calls_note_shape.name: calls_note_shape
calls_note_shape.value: "voice"."calls"."note" is null or char_length("voice"."calls"."note") between 1 and 2000

lines_label_shape.name: lines_label_shape
lines_label_shape.value: "voice"."lines"."label" is null or char_length("voice"."lines"."label") between 1 and 100

lines_assignment_matches_kind.name: lines_assignment_matches_kind
lines_assignment_matches_kind.value:
("voice"."lines"."assignment_kind" = 'team') = ("voice"."lines"."assignment_team_id" is not null)
        and ("voice"."lines"."assignment_kind" = 'rep') = ("voice"."lines"."assignment_membership_id" is not null)

recordings_stored.name: recordings_stored
recordings_stored.value: ("voice"."recordings"."state" <> 'storing' or ("voice"."recordings"."stored_at" is null and "voice"."recordings"."size_bytes" is null)) and ("voice"."recordings"."state" <> 'stored' or ("voice"."recordings"."stored_at" is not null and "voice"."recordings"."size_bytes" is not null))
